title: South Florida this week: FSU at Miami, Halloween bars, and a new speakeasy
igCaption:
FSU at Miami has a 7 p.m. kickoff on October 17, and Halloween events are rolling in Fort Lauderdale.
Room 901 runs its Carrie takeover October 8 through 31, and Hogwharf returns after a three-year hiatus.
@intermiamicf hosts open training for season ticket members at Nu Stadium on October 21.

Sources: seminoles.com, Orlando Sentinel, Haute Living, Miami New Times, WebWire

#MiamiEvents #FortLauderdale #SouthFlorida #HalloweenMiami

scenes.text: FSU at Miami has a kickoff time, and South Florida has Halloween events lined up in Fort Lauderdale.
Florida State at Miami is set for seven p.m. on October seventeenth. The Orlando Sentinel lists Miami as number four.
scenes.caption: Florida State at Miami is set for 7:00 p.m. on October 17. The Orlando Sentinel lists Miami as No. 4.

scenes.text: Marc Anthony has a private speakeasy at HQ Residences Miami. Haute Living posted it on October fifth.
scenes.caption: Marc Anthony has a private speakeasy at HQ Residences Miami. Haute Living posted it on October 5.

scenes.text: Room 901 inside Hyatt Centric Las Olas turns into a Carrie-inspired 1970s prom from October eighth through Halloween. The setup has red-and-black décor, candlelight, dramatic florals, and Prom Punch. If you end up at Room 901, NEAR shows who else was there.

scenes.text: Hogwharf returns to the Wharf Fort Lauderdale from October ninth through eleventh after a three-year hiatus. Expect floating candles, house flags, a Chamber of Secrets photo wall, and four specialty cocktails.

scenes.text: Inter Miami hosts open training for season ticket members at Nu Stadium on Wednesday, October twenty-first.
scenes.caption: Inter Miami hosts open training for season ticket members at Nu Stadium on Wednesday, October 21.

scenes.text: Which one are you going to, and what should we cover next? A night like this is full of faces you recognize but never meet, and NEAR is what shows you who that person walking past you actually was.
